title: Liability cap
text: Vendor liability should be capped at fees paid or payable in the preceding 12 months, except for agreed carve-outs.

title: Mutual indemnity
text: Indemnity obligations should be clearly scoped, proportionate, and include appropriate mutual protections where applicable.

title: Termination rights
text: The agreement should provide a reasonable termination-for-convenience or cure mechanism where commercially appropriate.

title: Auto-renewal notice
text: Automatic renewal should include a clear renewal period and a reasonable advance notice window for non-renewal.

title: Payment terms
text: Payment terms, due dates, disputed-invoice handling, and late fees should be explicit and commercially reasonable.

title: Confidential information
text: Confidentiality obligations should define protected information, permitted disclosures, exclusions, and survival period.
